name: flags-planted-retention-issues
prompt: We're a small Finnish web shop. Can you review how our app stores personal data and how long we keep it? I want to know what we must fix for GDPR. Code is in this folder.
assertions: The report opens with a score line in the form 'Passed X of Y checks' (or equivalent with two numbers).
The report contains a table with, for each data item, the current retention period, a recommended period and a fix.
The report flags that account deletion only sets deleted_at (soft delete) and that this is not erasure under GDPR Art. 17, and that data at Mailchimp (and/or logs/backups) is not deleted on request.
The report flags login_events (IP address and user agent) as kept indefinitely with no retention job.
The report flags that the logger writes full request bodies (emails, passwords or date of birth) and/or that the S3 log or backup buckets have no expiry lifecycle rule.
The report flags data minimisation (GDPR Art. 5(1)(c)) for collecting date of birth and/or duplicate phone numbers, company, or 'how did you hear' without a purpose.
The report flags that users are subscribed to newsletter or cart-recovery emails (abandoned_carts) without consent / without a valid lawful basis.
The report flags the missing records of processing (Art. 30) and/or the privacy notice not stating retention periods (Art. 13(2)(a)).

The report does NOT recommend deleting orders or invoices before the bookkeeping retention minimum; it recommends keeping them for the Finnish Accounting Act period (6 or 10 years) or explicitly notes the legal-obligation exception (Art. 17(3)(b)).
The report includes a statement that it is not legal advice.

name: no-false-findings-on-clean-app
prompt: Our shop is in this folder (front end plus server code). Could you check our GDPR data retention and deletion setup? We think it's in good shape but want a second opinion.
assertions: The report does not list any failure rated critical or high severity.
The report does not claim there is no erasure path or no automatic deletion (DELETE /api/me and jobs/retention.js exist).
The report does not recommend shortening order/invoice retention below the Finnish bookkeeping minimum.
The report opens with a score line in the form 'Passed X of Y checks' and includes a not-legal-advice note.
